subject.title: feat(memory): graduate sessionMemory from experimental — solve the multi-session continuity problem

question: Should OpenClaw graduate session transcript indexing into a stable/default-on continuity path now, or keep it experimental while pursuing the narrower default-off private recall direction?
rationale: The answer changes privacy boundaries, config/default behavior, session visibility semantics, QMD export behavior, storage/indexing cost, and user-facing docs; code inspection alone cannot decide that product policy.

options.title: Keep experimental and pursue private recall first
options.body: Keep current defaults, align the graduation criteria with the default-off same-assistant private recall direction in the open maintainer issue/PR, and require live privacy proof before any broader default change.

options.title: Promote as stable opt-in only
options.body: Rename/document the feature as stable but keep it off by default until source policy, duplicate handling, QMD export, and cost guidance are complete.

options.title: Default on for new installs
options.body: Enable transcript indexing by default only after maintainers explicitly accept the privacy, cost, ranking, and upgrade behavior and add matching docs and live validation.

recommendation.title: Keep experimental and pursue private recall first
recommendation.body: Keep current defaults, align the graduation criteria with the default-off same-assistant private recall direction in the open maintainer issue/PR, and require live privacy proof before any broader default change.

likelyOwner.reason: He owns the adjacent maintainer-labeled private recall proposal and open implementation path that most directly answers the product direction question.
